Instructions: Lie flat on bench, retract scapulae, lower bar to mid-chest, press up explosively.
Set bench to 30 degrees incline. Press dumbbells in an arching motion.
Maintain slight elbow bend, stretch pectorals at bottom, squeeze together at top.
Stand tall, brace core and glutes, press bar overhead vertically.
Raise arms laterally to shoulder height with slight elbow flexion.
Descend by breaking at hips and knees simultaneously, keep chest tall.
Place feet shoulder-width, lower sled with control, do not lock out knees.
Hinge at hips, keep bar close to shins, feel stretch in hamstrings.
Hip hinge from the floor, brace lats and core, pull bar smoothly.
Pronated grip, pull until chin clears the bar, control the eccentric.
